title: 'We will be able to defend Ukraine' thanks to EU loan: Ambassador Vsevolod Chentsov
summary: As part of FRANCE 24’s and Talking Europe’s coverage of the fourth anniversary of the war in Ukraine, we host veteran diplomat Vsevolod Chentsov, Ukraine’s ambassador to the European Union.
